register.labelZh: LEAP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: leap at 可以表示某人欣然接受機會或提議。；leap on 或 leap upon 可以描述某人迅速回應一宗新聞、一句評論、一個錯誤或一項細節。；leap out at 可以表示名字、顏色、數字或錯誤立即引起注意。；leap up 可以生動地表示人或動物突然站起來。
register.summaryEn: Leap at helps you show that someone accepts a chance or offer eagerly. Leap on or leap upon helps you describe someone quickly reacting to a story, comment, mistake or detail. Leap out at helps you show that a name, colour, number or mistake is noticed at once. Leap up gives a lively way to describe someone or an animal standing suddenly.
